title: Open, Review, and Merge a Pull Request
description: Push a new feature branch to your GitHub repository, open a well-documented Pull Request, review the diff, and merge it.
steps: In `hcc-git-practice`, create a new branch: `git switch -c feature/contributor-guide`
Create a file `CONTRIBUTING.md` explaining how others can contribute to your practice repo
Stage and commit: `git add CONTRIBUTING.md && git commit -m "docs: add contributor guidelines"`
Push the branch to GitHub: `git push -u origin feature/contributor-guide`
Open your repository on GitHub in your browser — click the green 'Compare & pull request' button
Write Description: include `### Summary` (what this adds) and `### Verification` (how you tested)
Click the 'Files changed' tab — review your own diff (notice green additions)
Return to the 'Conversation' tab and click 'Merge pull request' → 'Confirm merge'
Click 'Delete branch' to clean up the remote branch on GitHub!
expected_output: Your PR shows the purple 'Merged' badge on GitHub and `CONTRIBUTING.md` is now live on `main`.
tips: Base branch is where changes go (usually `main`); Compare/Head branch is where your changes come from.
A great PR description makes life easy for the reviewer — always explain *why* you made the change.
